svg.title: Moldova study map
svg.desc: Representative places for orientation. These dots are not legal wine-area boundaries. Named towns locate the surrounding study area; the country window may omit distant territory. 1: Codru near Ialoveni; 2: Ștefan Vodă; 3: Purcari; 4: Valul lui Traian near Comrat; 5: Cahul; 6: Tiraspol; 7: Bălți; 8: Dubăsari

g.title: 4 · Valul lui Traian near Comrat: representative location

g.text: Light markers: study locations · dark markers: geographic context · teal: water

text.tspan: Follow the land. Compare the wines.
Open this map in the Codex for terroir, grapes, growing, cellar
choices and service. Dots locate places; they do not define a wine
